title: Team Europe Commits €57.8 Million to South African Green Hydrogen and Minerals Projects
detail: At the African Green Hydrogen Summit in Cape Town on September 15, 2026, the European Union together with Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands ('Team Europe') launched two Global Gateway projects worth more than R1 billion (€57.8 million) to support South Africa's green hydrogen industry and local mineral and battery supply chains. The package, implemented by Germany's GIZ and KfW development agencies with South African development finance institutions, includes a €20.5 million facility aimed at helping green hydrogen and Power-to-X projects reach bankability, plus grants, equity and concessional capital to strengthen policy frameworks and crowd in private investment. EU Commissioner for International Partnerships Jozef Sikela said the initiative shows 'how Team Europe, together with South Africa, can create the right conditions for private investors to enter markets with high potential.' The funding is part of a broader Team Europe Global Gateway package for South Africa exceeding R200 billion (~€11.6 billion), and coincided with President Cyril Ramaphosa's government naming the first wave of six priority green hydrogen projects, including a Saldanha Bay sustainable-aviation-fuel project that reached a final investment decision.

title: Juniper Green Energy Expands Operational Renewable Portfolio to 2,689 MW Across India
detail: India's Juniper Green Energy announced in mid-September 2026 that it commissioned 101 MW of new wind capacity across Gujarat, Maharashtra and Rajasthan -- including a 45 MW and 40 MW wind tranche under the GUVNL Hybrid Phase I and II programs and a 10 MW tranche for Maharashtra's MSEDCL -- taking its total operational renewable portfolio to 2,689 MWp plus 503 MWh of battery energy storage. A 75 MW solar + 25 MW wind hybrid project for MSEDCL was completed roughly two months ahead of schedule. The company commissioned 601 MWp of renewable capacity (458 MWp solar, 143 MW wind) plus about 400 MWh of storage in the first quarter of its FY27 alone, and holds a broader pipeline exceeding 11 GW across operational, under-construction, contracted and awarded projects, part of the wave of corporate renewable buildout underpinning India's push past 50% non-fossil installed power capacity in 2026.

media.caption: Juniper Green Energy's operational wind and solar portfolio reached 2,689 MW after new wind commissioning across Gujarat, Maharashtra and Rajasthan
